description: For tracked Texas data-center sites, return each milestone (permit, interconnection, energized) with its status, date, source link, the verbatim quote or registry field, and how the source is linked to the company. A milestone is shown only when the company's own SEC filing names the site or the permit holder is its Exhibit 21 subsidiary (filing cited); a name match alone never counts. state "none" = no public source found; "unconfirmed" = a source exists but its company link is not proven, so nothing from it is returned. Give site (slug) or record_id (e.g. SX-07-A-0002); omit both to list all sites.

record_id.description: A Seraphix record id, e.g. SX-07-A-0002.

name: tx_site_status

cite.description: Cite this: the attribution line for this response (CC BY 4.0). Each milestone cites its own source_url.

title: Texas data-center site milestones: permit, interconnection, energized
